title: Dictator and Singleton Monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i$ be one of its coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The real-valued version of the dictator on coordinate $i$ at $x$ equals the monomial indexed by the singleton set $\{i\}$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n
